items.title: What Is IBM (IBM) Signaling With Its Quantum System Two Launch In Chicago?
items.summary: International Business Machines (NYSE:IBM) has deployed its Quantum System Two computer in Chicago at the Illinois Quantum and Microelectronics Park. The new installation connects IBM with Illinois research universities, state agencies, and corporate partners focused on quantum information science.
